title: The category structure induced on the filtered object colimit
statement: For a small filtered category J and a functor F : J → Cat of small categories, let O be the colimit of its object sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist a category structure on O and functors V_j : F(j) → O whose object maps are the object coprojections and which commute strictly with every transition functor. There is a colimit cocone of the sets of arrows [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] equipped with an equivalence to Arrow O intertwining its coprojections with the arrow maps of V_j.

Then source, target, and composition are inherited ... Remark that given any finite diagram in C there exists an i such that this diagram is the image of a diagram in C_i' (stated without proof); filtered colimits of sets: categories.tex Section Tag 04AX

proof.text: Represent objects and arrows by elements of the two filtered colimits of sets. For any finite collection of representatives, filteredness supplies a common later stage; the equality criterion in the reviewed elementwise filtered-colimit lemma then shows that source, target, identities and composition are independent of representatives. The same criterion proves the category axioms and that each coprojection is a functor, with v_{j'} v_phi = v_j.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_category_structure (J : Type z) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z}) : let O := colimit (F ⋙ Cat.objects) ∃ (s : Category.{z} O), letI := s ∃ V : ∀ j : J, F.obj j ⥤ O, (∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j), (V j).obj X = colimit.ι (F ⋙ Cat.objects) j X) ∧ (∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), (F.map f).toFunctor ⋙ V k = V j) ∧ (∃ (a : Cocone (F ⋙ Cat.arrows)) (e : a.pt ≃ Arrow O), Nonempty (IsColimit a) ∧ ∀ (j : J) (f : Arrow (F.obj j)), e (a.ι.app j f) = (V j).mapArrow.obj f)
